title: The Inscribed Square Problem
exact_target: Must every simple closed continuous plane curve contain the four vertices of a square of positive side length?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1163 (GEO-008). CC BY 4.0.
Joshua Evan Greene and Andrew Lobb, \emph{Square pegs between two graphs}, arXiv:2407.07798 (2024), Section 1, definition of inscription and the Square Peg Problem.
